b1-24-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Using the Machine
b1-24-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg, a student, visits your office in Budapest and wants to use the machine there. You tell her how it works.
b1-24-01.prompt: Tell Meg how to use the machine.
cues: Say what is put into the machine
Say what is pressed to start
b1-24-01.target: Se introduce la tarjeta en la máquina y se pulsa este botón.
b1-24-01.english: The card is put into the machine and this button is pressed.
b1-24-01.canDo: I can explain how something works using impersonal constructions.

b1-24-02.title: Communicative Challenge: First, Next, Finally
b1-24-02.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos has to start the machine at his office in Budapest for the first time. You know the steps and tell him the order.
b1-24-02.prompt: Tell Carlos the three steps in order.
cues: Say what is done at the end
b1-24-02.target: Primero, se enciende la máquina. A continuación, se introduce el material. Finalmente, se comprueba el resultado.
b1-24-02.english: First, the machine is switched on. Next, the material is inserted. Finally, the result is checked.
b1-24-02.canDo: I can sequence the stages of a process clearly.

b1-24-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Made in Spain
b1-24-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Your office in Budapest has a new product from Spain. Meg asks you where it is made and what it is made of.
b1-24-03.prompt: Tell Meg where the product is made and how many parts it has.
cues: Say how many parts it has
b1-24-03.target: El producto se fabrica en España. Está compuesto de tres partes.
b1-24-03.english: The product is made in Spain. It is made up of three parts.
b1-24-03.canDo: I can describe what objects are made of and how they are produced.

b1-24-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Saving Energy
b1-24-04.scenario: You are Meg. At the language school in Budapest there is a new system. You explain to Carlos how it saves energy.
b1-24-04.prompt: Tell Carlos how the system reduces energy use and what is checked at the end.
cues: Say how energy use is reduced
Say what is checked at the end
b1-24-04.target: Mediante este sistema, se reduce el consumo de energía. Por último, se comprueba que todo funciona correctamente.
b1-24-04.english: By means of this system, energy consumption is reduced. Lastly, it is checked that everything works correctly.
b1-24-04.canDo: I can explain a process using connectors.

b1-24-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Margarita's Shirt
b1-24-05.scenario: You are Meg. You read a retelling of «La camisa de Margarita», a tale by Ricardo Palma, for a class in Budapest. Carlos asks what happens.
b1-24-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what Margarita's father swears and what the shirt is like.
cues: Say what the shirt is like
b1-24-05.target: Don Raimundo jura que solo dará a su hija la camisa de novia. La camisa es muy cara.
b1-24-05.english: Don Raimundo swears that he will give his daughter only the wedding shirt. The shirt is very expensive.
b1-24-05.canDo: I can give a complete explanation of a procedure.

b1-24-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: From First to Last
b1-24-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks you at your office in Budapest how a process works from the first step to the last.
b1-24-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg the steps of the process in order.
cues: Say what is checked at the end
b1-24-consolidation.target: Primero se prepara el material. Después se introduce en la máquina y, por último, se comprueba el resultado.
b1-24-consolidation.english: First the material is prepared. Then it is inserted into the machine and, lastly, the result is checked.
b1-24-consolidation.canDo: I can use the process words of this unit.
